place: Lipa Noi, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: Beachfront Twin-Villa Estate with Five Islands Sunsets
note: Fully staffed · resident chef · daily breakfast · price on request
blurb: Two contemporary villas on a private beachfront estate at Lipa Noi, on Samui's calm west coast — a low-rise garden villa opening onto a 15-metre infinity pool and lawn that runs to the sand, and a three-level sea-view villa behind it with its own pool. Eight en-suite bedrooms, a resident chef and team, and sunsets over the Five Islands.
detail:
On the quiet west coast of Koh Samui, where the water at Lipa Noi stays shallow and calm and the Five Islands sit on the horizon, this private estate brings together two contemporary villas on a single stretch of beach. The evenings are the draw — the sun sets directly across the bay — and the soft, gently shelving sand makes it an easy place for children to swim.

The beachfront garden villa is low and open, its living pavilion and dining room looking across an L-shaped 15-metre infinity pool and lawn to the sea, with a beachside sala for massage or a book and a poolside bar for sunset drinks. Behind it, a three-level sea-view villa centres on its own infinity pool and terrace, with a separate kitchen, a television room behind folding glass and, between the two houses, a games room with a full-size billiards table. Interiors are clean and modern — polished concrete, timber and Asian artefacts — with dining for up to twenty indoors or out.

Eight en-suite bedrooms across both villas sleep sixteen, with king beds, crisp linens and bathrooms with rain showers or deep tubs; the estate can be taken in part for smaller groups. A villa manager, resident chef and housekeeping team look after the stay — breakfast each morning, Thai and international menus on request, barbecues on the lawn or beach — and the setting lends itself well to small weddings and celebrations. Kayaks, paddleboards and snorkelling gear are on hand, and Nathon's markets and waterfront are ten minutes away.
